steps.title: Upload MZmine data to GNPS
steps.instruction: Upload the processed data files generated by MZmine to the GNPS platform (https://gnps.ucsd.edu).

steps.title: Run Feature‑Based Molecular Networking
steps.instruction: In GNPS, execute Feature‑Based Molecular Networking (FBMN) to construct a molecular network treating each feature independently (Nothias et al., 2020).

steps.title: Visualize Network with Cytoscape
steps.instruction: Download the FBMN results and open them in Cytoscape (https://cytoscape.org) for network visualization.

steps.title: Match MS/MS Spectra to In‑silico Library
steps.instruction: Compare experimental MS/MS spectra against theoretical spectra generated in silico from known natural product structures.

steps.title: Annotate Compounds from Matches
steps.instruction: Assign annotations to compounds when a match is found, following criteria from Allard et al., 2016 and Mohimani et al., 2017.

steps.title: Predict Formulas and Structural Candidates
steps.instruction: Use the MS/MS fragmentation data to predict molecular formulas, propose structural candidates, or assign chemical classes.

steps.title: Insert Individual Spectra for Database Search
steps.instruction: Add individual MS/MS spectra to the workflow and query them against public experimental databases.

steps.title: Manually Interpret Fragmentation Patterns
steps.instruction: Manually examine the fragmentation patterns of each ion to confirm or refute the automatic annotations.

steps.title: Infer Modifications and Propagate Annotations
steps.instruction: Based on structural similarity and fragmentation logic, infer molecular modifications and propagate these to propose annotations for related compounds.
